question.de: Finde Myitkyina im hohen Norden Myanmars.
question.hu: Keresd meg Myitkyinat Mianmar tavoli eszaki reszen.
question.ro: Gaseste Myitkyina in nordul indepartat al Myanmarului.
question.en: Find Myitkyina in far northern Myanmar.

question.de: Finde die archaeologische Zone von Bagan in Zentralmyanmar.
question.hu: Keresd meg Bagan regeszeti ovezetet Mianmar kozepso reszen.
question.ro: Gaseste zona arheologica Bagan in centrul Myanmarului.
question.en: Find the Bagan Archaeological Zone in central Myanmar.

question.de: Klicke auf die Shwedagon-Pagode in Yangon.
question.hu: Kattints a yangoni Shwedagon pagodara.
question.ro: Apasa pe Pagoda Shwedagon din Yangon.
question.en: Click the Shwedagon Pagoda in Yangon.

question.de: Finde Hpa-An im Suedosten Myanmars.
question.hu: Keresd meg Hpa-Ant Mianmar delkeleti reszen.
question.ro: Gaseste Hpa-An in sud-estul Myanmarului.
question.en: Find Hpa-An in southeastern Myanmar.

question.de: Finde den Strand von Ngapali an der Westkueste.
question.hu: Keresd meg az Ngapali partot a nyugati tengerparton.
question.ro: Gaseste plaja Ngapali de pe coasta vestica.
question.en: Find Ngapali Beach on the western coast.

question.de: Finde den Inle-See im Shan-Hochland.
question.hu: Keresd meg az Inle-to t a Shan-fennsikon.
question.ro: Gaseste lacul Inle din Podisul Shan.
question.en: Find Inle Lake in the Shan Highlands.

question.de: Klicke auf den Staat Kachin im Norden.
question.hu: Kattints az eszaki Kachin allamra.
question.ro: Apasa pe statul Kachin din nord.
question.en: Click Kachin State in the north.

question.de: Finde den Staat Shan im Osten Myanmars.
question.hu: Keresd meg a keleti Shan allamot.
question.ro: Gaseste statul Shan din estul Myanmarului.
question.en: Find Shan State in eastern Myanmar.

question.de: Klicke auf die Region Yangon im Sueden.
question.hu: Kattints a deli Yangon regi ora.
question.ro: Apasa pe regiunea Yangon din sud.
question.en: Click the Yangon Region in the south.

question.de: Finde die lange Kuestenregion Tanintharyi im aeussersten Sueden.
question.hu: Keresd meg a hosszu tengerparti Tanintharyi regiot a legdelibb reszen.
question.ro: Gaseste lunga regiune de coasta Tanintharyi din extremul sud.
question.en: Find the long Tanintharyi coastal region in the far south.

question.de: Welche dieser Staedte liegt am weitesten im Norden?
question.hu: Melyik varos fekszik a legeszakabbra?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orase se afla cel mai la nord?
question.en: Which of these cities lies farthest north?

question.de: Welche dieser Staedte liegt am weitesten im Osten?
question.hu: Melyik varos fekszik a legkeletebbre?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orase se afla cel mai la est?
question.en: Which of these cities lies farthest east?

question.de: Welcher dieser Orte ist ein See?
question.hu: Ezek kozul melyik hely egy to?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste locuri este un lac?
question.en: Which of these places is a lake?

question.de: Welcher dieser Orte liegt bei Mandalay?
question.hu: Ezek kozul melyik hely talalhato Mandalay kozeleben?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste locuri se afla langa Mandalay?
question.en: Which of these places is near Mandalay?

question.de: Welche dieser Staedte liegt am weitesten im Sueden?
question.hu: Melyik varos fekszik a legdelebbre?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orase se afla cel mai la sud?
question.en: Which of these cities lies farthest south?

question.de: Klicke Myitkyina, Bagan, Naypyidaw und Mawlamyine von Norden nach Sueden an.
question.hu: Kattints Myitkyinara, Baganra, Naypyidawra es Mawlamyine-re eszakrol delre.
question.ro: Apasa pe Myitkyina, Bagan, Naypyidaw si Mawlamyine de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Myitkyina, Bagan, Naypyidaw, and Mawlamyine from north to south.

question.de: Klicke Sittwe, Magway, Naypyidaw und Taunggyi von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Sittwere, Magwayre, Naypyidawra es Taunggyire nyugatrol keletre.
question.ro: Apasa pe Sittwe, Magway, Naypyidaw si Taunggyi de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Sittwe, Magway, Naypyidaw, and Taunggyi from west to east.

question.de: Klicke Yangon, Dawei, Myeik und Kawthaung von Norden nach Sueden an.
question.hu: Kattints Yangonra, Daweire, Myeikre es Kawthaungra eszakrol delre.
question.ro: Apasa pe Yangon, Dawei, Myeik si Kawthaung de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Yangon, Dawei, Myeik, and Kawthaung from north to south.

question.de: Klicke Mandalay, Pyin Oo Lwin, Hsipaw und Lashio von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Mandalayra, Pyin Oo Lwinre, Hsipawra es Lashi ora nyugatrol keletre.
question.ro: Apasa pe Mandalay, Pyin Oo Lwin, Hsipaw si Lashio de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Mandalay, Pyin Oo Lwin, Hsipaw, and Lashio from west to east.

question.de: Klicke Bagan, den Mandalay-Palast, den Inle-See und Kengtung von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Baganra, a Mandalay-palotara, az Inle-to ra es Kengtungra nyugatrol keletre.
question.ro: Apasa pe Bagan, Palatul Mandalay, lacul Inle si Kengtung de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Bagan, Mandalay Palace, Inle Lake, and Kengtung from west to east.
